notes: PDF read via text extraction (pages 1-10, incl. references); figures 1-4 and Tables 1-2 are images whose content is described in the text. Clause counts (1600, 10000, 500, 5168/10336) are printed without saying per class or total, so clauses_scope is not_reported. '100 states' / '500 states' are N = states per action (Fig. 3). n_runs=10 for the CV datasets means 10 repetitions of 10-fold CV (100 fold evaluations). Hyper-parameters were tuned by manual grid search; the data used for tuning is not stated, hence selection_on_test not_reported. The text calls the 20 Newsgroups table 'Table 1' but it is captioned Table 3. Clinical n_classes is not stated (the running example is Allergy vs No Allergy). Unigram+quadrigram tokenization and InfoGain selection are stated for the Weka preprocessing that 'replicates the TM configuration'; it is not explicit which TM inputs contained quadrigrams, so booleanization is recorded as term presence. Text says run time in hours is reported for the clinical dataset, but Table 5 has no such column; GPU speed-up only as 5-15x.
